title: A Leo presents the report like it's the Oscars.
old_caption:
Ever had a coworker turn a status meeting into an awards show?
Leo opens the envelope and names the whole team. Lead warm, share the light.

title: A Libra at 3 AM: did I say yes to too much?
old_caption:
Said yes to four plans on one Saturday so nobody felt left out?
Libra learns that saying no is balanced too. Friends still love you.

title: POV: a Libra picks an outfit. Day three.
old_caption:
Still deciding on an outfit on day three?
Libra weighs pink against mint, then asks the real question: which one feels like me?

title: 'Where should we eat?' A Libra, for 45 minutes.
old_caption:
Has your group spent 45 minutes deciding where to eat?
Libra weighs every menu until Taurus just orders tacos for everyone.

title: Libra on a date: matching outfits, by accident.
old_caption:
Showing up to a date in the exact same scarf as them?
Libra and Aries take turns choosing. Balance is a team sport.

title: A Libra mediating the office fight.
old_caption:
Always the one settling every argument at work?
Libra brings peace to the coffee machine, and the team makes sure fair includes Libra.

title: A Pisces at 3 AM, crying at a dog commercial.
old_caption:
Crying at a dog commercial at 3 AM? Pisces gets it.
Feel it all, then feet on the floor, a glass of water, and breathe.

title: POV: a Pisces wakes up still in the dream.
old_caption:
Ever woken up and stayed half inside your dream?
Pisces was a kind whale all night. Dream big, then drink some water.

title: A Pisces is everyone's 2 AM phone call.
old_caption:
Are you the friend everyone calls at 2 AM?
Pisces listens to four calls in a row, then the water signs listen back. Save some you for you.

title: Dating a Pisces: they wrote you a song on date one.
old_caption:
Would you write someone a song for date one?
Pisces does, and Virgo fixes one typo and keeps the rest. Feel it with them.
